decisions.Kwic: 坐禪者，大似擔雪填井。吟詩者，何異捏雪成團？惟有說食者卻最親切。

Decision.AttributionNote: 天岸昇禪師語錄, winter informal address. Tian'an Sheng is the exact speaker of the stored comparison: sitting meditation resembles carrying snow to fill a well, composing verse resembles pinching snow into a ball, while speaking of food is closest.

decisions.Kwic: 將山河大地、艸木叢林、若僧若俗、若聖若凡納入芥子，而芥子不見其窄。

Decision.AttributionNote: 天岸昇禪師語錄, end-of-winter informal address. Tian'an Sheng is the exact speaker: he says that the previous year he put mountains, rivers, the whole earth, plants, monastics and laypeople, sages and ordinary people into a mustard seed without narrowing it.

decisions.Kwic: 一轉語是殺人刀、一轉語是活人劍、一轉語殺活同時、一轉語殺活不同時

Decision.AttributionNote: 天岸昇禪師語錄, precept-giving hall address. Tian'an Sheng is the exact speaker of the stored four-turn formulation, distinguishing the killing knife, the life-giving sword, killing and giving life simultaneously, and killing and giving life at different times.

decisions.Kwic: 一轉語是殺人刀、一轉語是活人劍、一轉語殺活同時、一轉語殺活不同時。

Decision.AttributionNote: 天岸昇禪師語錄, precept-giving hall address. Tian'an Sheng is the exact speaker of the stored four-turn formulation in which one turning phrase is the killing knife and another is the life-giving sword.

decisions.Kwic: 設若今日冷灰豆爆，便見條抽石筍，燄吐冰河，鐵樹開華，木人撫掌。

Decision.AttributionNote: 天岸昇禪師語錄, winter-solstice public exchange and address. Tian'an Sheng is the exact speaker of the stored conditional statement: if today a bean explodes in cold ashes, stone shoots branch, flames rise from the frozen river, the iron tree flowers, and the wooden person claps.
